response.justification: While this candidate demonstrates exceptional breadth of software engineering experience and strong fundamental skills, they are fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirements. The position explicitly requires hands-on C++ development with emphasis on multi-threading, networking, and industrial cybersecurity (SDL, IEC 62443). The candidate's professional C++ experience is limited to 6 months in 2014-2015; their career trajectory over the past decade has been focused on TypeScript/Node.js full-stack web development. Furthermore, there is zero demonstrated background in industrial automation, IoT applications, or industrial security protocols required for manufacturing automation. While advantageous skills like React and Node.js are present, they cannot substitute for the specialized C++ and domain expertise this role demands.
strengths: Extensive 20-year software development career exceeding stated experience requirements of 8-12 years
Proven mentoring and teaching capability with multiple courses, workshops, and community contributions demonstrating knowledge sharing ability
Strong full-stack capabilities with React and Node.js, directly matching the role's advantageous skills
concerns: Critically limited recent C++ experience—only 6 months professionally (Dec 2014-June 2015); current role and past 10+ years focused on TypeScript/Node.js, indicating significant skill atrophy in required language
Complete absence of industrial automation, IoT, or embedded systems background; no mention of industrial protocols (Modbus, IEC standards) or any manufacturing domain experience
No evidence of security expertise (SDL, IEC 62443, secure development lifecycle) or cybersecurity practices required for this role; career has not touched these domains

key_factors.factor: Industrial domain and security expertise absence
